title: Diwali Pahat London 2026
address: Richmond Park, Richmond, Surrey, TW10 5HX, United Kingdom
description:
A Little Piece of Maharashtra, Right Here in London.

This Diwali, join Mirari for a special celebration of light, music, art and togetherness in the beautiful surroundings of Richmond Park.

Inspired by the cherished tradition of Diwali Pahat, this cultural gathering brings the warmth of Maharashtra's festive celebrations to London.

Come together with friends, families and fellow culture lovers for a morning filled with festive music, creative activities, traditional experiences and joyful memories.

Whether you're celebrating familiar traditions or discovering them for the first time, everyone is welcome.
lineup:
Planned highlights, subject to confirmation:

Diwali Pahat Music — festive traditional melodies and contemporary fusion sounds.
Make Your Own Lantern — a creative activity inspired by traditional Diwali kandils.
Diwali Killa — miniature forts inspired by the history of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
Festive Community Gathering — connect with London's Marathi and wider Indian community.
Diwali Food & Treats — traditional festive refreshments and food options, subject to final vendor arrangements.
